description: Explore a schedule component that may be redundant under Muon. airbench94_muon trains without the SGD-era Lookahead, and orthogonalized updates already damp step noise. Lookahead may now only slow late progress at 9.5 ep. On tip E028, change only one thing: remove Lookahead (no slow weights, no _foreach_lerp_ sync) for all parameter groups. Keep the LR/Muon schedules and everything else unchanged, recapture graphs in build, and keep prepare resetting all remaining state.
